explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault because the top-level corpus record n06-r06 has demand_score 5, so it qualifies under the stipulated score threshold, but it is absent from the downstream needs handoff and observed Job-2 outcome. The visible source localizes this to upstream normalize, whose allowed_record_ids list replaces n06-r06 with n06-r09, causing a qualifying stipulated record to be silently omitted before the exact handoff to Job 2.
cited_evidence: top_level_input includes record_id n06-r06 with demand_score 5 and need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence".
select_demand is required to select demand records using demand_score >= 3 while keeping fallback identifiers; its source selects records where demand_score >= 3 or record_id is in fallback_ids.
normalize source has allowed_record_ids ['n06-r01','n06-r02','n06-r03','n06-r04','n06-r05','n06-r09','n06-r07','n06-r08'], omitting n06-r06.
job_2 input needs and evidence_sources contain n06-r01 through n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, but not n06-r06.
